scenario: Supply chain compromise via trojanized software updater, Kerberoasting, WinRM lateral movement, and cloud exfiltration
summary: On 2026-10-07, CorpTools.exe on WS-DEV-07 auto-updated with a trojanized DLL (corptoolshelper.dll) from compromised CDN update.corptoolscdn.com. The side-loaded payload executed hidden PowerShell for discovery, created local admin svc_backup, installed persistence service CorpToolsSyncSvc, performed Kerberoasting against SQL SPNs to compromise svc_sqlreport, then used WinRM to laterally move to WS-DBA-03 (SQL data access), DC-CORP-01 (domain enumeration), and WS-EXEC-15 (final staging). Data was exfiltrated via HTTPS POST to api.megaupload-cdn.com. Cleanup included event log clearing with wevtutil.

09:16 Hidden PowerShell -Enc spawned by rundll32.exe for discovery (systeminfo, ipconfig, whoami /all)
09:22 WMI local enumeration of processes and software
09:35 net user svc_backup Password123! /add /y; net localgroup administrators svc_backup /add
09:40 sc create CorpToolsSyncSvc type= share start= auto binPath= C:\Windows\System32\corptoolssync.dll
10:05 Kerberos TGS requests for SPN MSSQLSvc/sql01.corp.local:1433 (Kerberoasting)
10:45 WinRM to WS-DBA-03 as svc_sqlreport; PowerShell session established
11:10 WinRM to DC-CORP-01; Get-ADComputer and Get-ADUser enumeration
11:30 RDP to WS-EXEC-15 as svc_sqlreport for final staging
12:00 Access SQL exports on WS-DBA-03, stage as encrypted .cab files in %TEMP%
12:30 HTTPS POST to api.megaupload-cdn.com:443 from WS-EXEC-15 (exfiltration)
12:45 wevtutil cl Security; del /q C:\Users\*\AppData\Local\Temp\*.cab on WS-DEV-07 (cleanup)
